integrity: The classical sextic formula and its elementary mod-two square are acknowledged as pre-existing implications; the asserted refinement is the four-component singular geometry and degree-14 nonlinear component.
scientific_limitations: Algebraically closed characteristic-two coefficient space for the three binary bilinear equations; reduced discriminant singular locus only, not its Jacobian scheme. Historical priority of the degree-14 component is provisional.
title: The four-component singular locus of the characteristic-two binary Nash cubic
